sources.scope: First hardening programme; does not prove physical mesh.
Report-age integration with conservative live uncertainty.
Preservation entry point; not a replacement application.

Anchor + assist + topology proposal and research lineage.

10_SOFTWARE_MAP.md. Proposed reusable meaning layer; no Loc8 runtime adoption.

concepts.name: Identity and permission
concepts.meaning: Who may see or act, for this crew/site/shift. A sender ID or consent enum is not authentication.

concepts.name: Source observation
concepts.meaning: Provider sample time, first receipt, measured accuracy, source and clock basis. Not a report or inferred location.

concepts.name: Position and floor estimate
concepts.meaning: A derived location/floor with age, confidence and evidence. Never silently turn uncertainty into precision.

concepts.name: Versioned place
concepts.meaning: Building, level, space and connector identities tied to a reviewed package and registration.

concepts.name: Communications reachability
concepts.meaning: Measured link/path availability for named device/state/direction/time cohorts, not geometry or crowd counts.

concepts.name: Operational intent
concepts.meaning: Immutable message/task identity, actor, destination and incident correlation.

concepts.name: Delivery evidence
concepts.meaning: Distinct local submission, relay receipt, destination receipt and human acknowledgement facts.

concepts.name: Human action and outcome
concepts.meaning: Acknowledgement, assignment, attendance and completion each require their own evidence.

concepts.name: Evidence and promotion
concepts.meaning: Source revision, trace hash, method, cohort, limitations and explicit promotion decision.

relations.meaning: indexes survey context; does not prove a link
informs delivery planning, never overrides safety
may inform; never implies human action

workstreams.name: One durable programme
workstreams.deliverable: Complete original-byte preservation, current branch receipts and one source-linked master plan. Never delete ignored work before inventory and verified backup.
workstreams.gate: Archive review, reference checks and exact byte verification. No app promotion implied.

workstreams.name: Shared ingress and lifecycle hardening
workstreams.deliverable: Strict packet ingress, bounded reassembly and generation-safe restart recovery in PR #1.
workstreams.gate: Exact-toolchain full regression, applicable app/native builds and review. Scoped tests are insufficient.

workstreams.name: Honest report freshness
workstreams.deliverable: Existing position records expose reported time separately from first receipt; unknown live clock basis stays unknown.
workstreams.gate: Remaining consumer migration, UI review, local-fix checks and complete toolchain.

workstreams.name: Original GPS sample provenance
workstreams.deliverable: Preserve original sample milliseconds and full accuracy locally; keep v1 publication timestamp/cadence; fix async watcher cleanup and real-mode demo fallback.
workstreams.gate: Stationary heartbeat, delayed callback, no-fix status, source-accuracy and cancellation regression; exact native/Expo checks still required.

workstreams.name: End-to-end observation semantics
workstreams.deliverable: Design capability-negotiated source metadata and trusted/uncertain clock handling; review own-fix age, remaining views and ranking. Do not overload legacy bytes.
workstreams.gate: Mixed-version fixtures, duplicated/late metadata, source/report correlation and no false fresh/found labels. Review before a wire-semantic change.

workstreams.name: Truthful command delivery
workstreams.deliverable: Immutable command/incident/recipient IDs; visible rejected/unknown submission; no simulated destination or human acknowledgement.
workstreams.gate: Loss, timeout, duplicates, wrong recipient/incident, late receipt and duress tests; keep no-drop features.

workstreams.name: Reviewed security and connected boundaries
workstreams.deliverable: Advance existing CONN-01 and SEC-05 contracts into real reviewed TLS, identity, site/role enforcement, signing and storage providers.
workstreams.gate: No provider promoted solely from interface tests. Independent review and end-to-end isolation, revocation, replay and recovery tests.

workstreams.name: Authorised connected pilot
workstreams.deliverable: Use the existing connected-first lane; do not make revenue universally depend on BLE proof. Do not label a plain WebSocket bridge production-safe.
workstreams.gate: Real authenticated transport, durable state, outage recovery and operator acceptance. No offline BLE claims by association.

workstreams.name: Measured phone mesh and adaptive relay experiment
workstreams.deliverable: First prove isolated A-B-C relaying and locked/mixed-OS states; then controlled native fanout against current baseline. Preserve sole bridges.
workstreams.gate: MESH-01 E01: 200 small control packets, >=95% within 10s, both directions, no duplicate app delivery, B-absent control. Background/battery cohorts separately.

workstreams.name: Commissioning and multi-floor evidence
workstreams.deliverable: Reuse existing semantic venue graph, plan registration, floor recorder and sensor replay. Add calibrated anchor + barometer/motion + topology evaluation.
workstreams.gate: Real-plan second-operator MAP-04 plus permissioned FLOOR cohorts; preserve unknown and manual correction. No certified egress claim.

workstreams.name: Durable Gateway and Anchor integration
workstreams.deliverable: One logical site brain with meshd/relayd/sited/syncd/provisiond/supervisord. Implement real atomic storage and restart/power-loss recovery; Anchor stays an extension.
workstreams.gate: Signing/storage provider review, target-hardware restart/concurrency/power-loss, uplink/downlink and Anchor/Gateway/LAN-loss tests.

workstreams.name: Coverage-aware operational venue model
workstreams.deliverable: Join versioned geometry, observation confidence, reachability and incident intent by stable references; do not collapse them into one score.
workstreams.gate: One existing synthetic site first, then measured survey cohort. Route/accessibility/hazard constraints cannot be overruled by radio coverage.

workstreams.name: Bounded interrupted delivery
workstreams.deliverable: Authenticated message identity, expiry, privacy-scoped retention, copy/retry budgets and durable recovery. Position snapshots may supersede; incident intent must not vanish.
workstreams.gate: Crash/restart, duplicate/partition, expiry, quota/fairness and scope isolation before enabling persistent couriers.

workstreams.name: Evidence-aware camera and glasses view
workstreams.deliverable: Keep existing glasses boundary; show last-frame age, pause/stall/disconnect/end/denial distinctly. No video over the 25-byte mesh.
workstreams.gate: Frozen-frame, wrong source, privacy revocation and reconnect tests with a separately authorised media transport.

workstreams.name: Optional semantic intent benchmark
workstreams.deliverable: Benchmark deterministic domain intents/templates and meaning-preserving encoding; an LLM never grants authority or invents a receipt. No new runtime dependency.
workstreams.gate: Compare bytes, critical semantic errors, ambiguity, rejection and version mismatch against existing ops grammar. Adopt only after a result.

workstreams.name: Cross-conversation adoption
workstreams.deliverable: Transfer named contracts, evidence and limitations into destination repositories. Preserve product and data separation.
workstreams.gate: Destination-specific acceptance/rejection note and tested remote-verified commit; a handoff is not completed integration.
